summary: This video provides a structured overview of an internal combustion engine, outlining the core components and their roles in converting fuel energy into mechanical work. It covers the cylinder block and head, crankcase and oil pan, lubrication and cooling passages, manifolds, gaskets, liners, pistons and rings, connecting rods, crankshaft, camshaft, flywheel, and the valve system, with explanations of flow types, lubrication paths, and timing mechanisms. The narration ties each part to its function in fuel combustion, power transmission, and engine efficiency.
title: Car Engine Parts & Their Functions Explained in Details | The Engineers Post
